title: nadlan-apartment v1
description: The facts of one apartment layout, written once by the developer's data or by our staff and never changed by a buyer. Frame: centimetres, origin at the plan's top-left, x to the right, y down, rotation in degrees clockwise. The 2D plan and the 3D interior are both drawn from this one document plus the buyer's nadlan-unit-design.

geometry_revision.description: Changes whenever any node, wall or opening changes. A buyer's design is valid only for the revision it was made on.

kind.description: sales-plan = redrawn from a plan the developer published; derived = drawn by us from published facts; schematic = generated from room count and area; example = an invented layout. The label is shown on every screen and every export.

ref.description: Where the plan came from (a URL or a private file reference). Never shown to buyers.

project.description: The project slug, or null for a layout that belongs to no project.

north_deg.description: Compass bearing of the sheet's up direction (-y). 0 means up is north.

nodes.description: Wall corners and junctions, by id.

t.description: Thickness in cm. 0 for a divider.

kind.description: Only a partition may ever move. A divider is the line between two open spaces, with no wall.

h.description: Height in cm when it differs from the level height (a rail, a low wall).

at.description: Distance in cm from the wall's a-end to the start of the opening.

names.description: Names in the site's other languages (en, fr, ru, ar).

at.description: A point inside the room. The room is whichever closed space of the wall graph contains it, so room outlines and areas are always computed, never typed.

floor.description: The finish key of the base specification for this room.

points.description: The services points of the specification: electrical, lighting, communication and air conditioning. A wall point sits on one face of a wall; a ceiling light stands at a plan position. A buyer's design moves, adds or removes them (nadlan-unit-design.points).

at.description: cm from the wall's a-end (in the base plan; when a corner beside it slides the point keeps its place in the building, like an opening).

room.description: The room on whose side of the wall the point is.

h.description: Height above the floor in cm. Defaults: socket 30, switch 110, data 30, tv 110, ac 220.

starter.description: Furniture the designer opens with for this layout (illustration only, never part of the price). Same frame and fields as nadlan-unit-design items.

fixed.description: Things the buyer cannot move: columns, shafts, drains, the electrical board.

code.description: room.min_width is applied to axis-aligned rectangular rooms only (the only rooms with a true clear width); room.min_area to every room. mamad.no_chasing: no new point and no partition fixed to the safe room's walls or ceiling without the approved detail (placeholder, source to be verified).

source.description: The regulation, the standard or the developer policy the value comes from. A rule without a verified source is not shown to buyers as a legal fact.

view.description: What the windows see: the rendered city view for this tower, floor and side.
